justification: Inspected byte-buddy-dep/src/main/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/constant/SerializedConstant.java and byte-buddy-dep/src/test/java/net/bytebuddy/implementation/bytecode/constant/SerializedConstantTest.java. The class is only 107 lines, has one field and two operations (`of(...)` and `apply(...)`), and both are tightly focused on a single responsibility: serialize a `Serializable` value and emit bytecode to deserialize it. The test covers only null handling and serialization behavior. I did not find multiple cohesive responsibilities, a large method set, or enough structural complexity to indicate insufficient modularization.
